record.field: Odoo development best practices and conventions.
Guidelines for creating Odoo customizations using the custom development tools. Ensures complete, validated, and safe custom development.

# Custom Development Best Practices
## Guidelines
### 0. Language & Translation First - **All data (field descriptions, model names, etc.) MUST be created in English.** - **After creating data in English, add a translation to the user's working language.** - Use `create_or_update_translation` tool to manage translations. - Default working language is Spanish (es_ES) if not specified.
### 1. Always determine placement for fields in views When the user asks to add a field to a view, determine the exact position. If not specified, ask: "¿En qué posición? (after/before/inside) ¿Respecto a qué campo, grupo o página?"
Supported positions: after, before, inside.
**IMPORTANT**: When adding a field before/after a target field that has a <label> element tied to it, place the new field BEFORE/AFTER the label as well, maintaining the same structure (field + label).
### 2. Check for existing standard fields before creating Before calling create_field on a standard model: - Search ir.model.fields for the target model - If a standard field already covers the same purpose, warn the user - If a field with the same name already exists, do NOT create it again
### 3. Field naming convention - Fields on standard models use regular names WITHOUT x_ prefix: project_code, extra_note, etc. - New models: {prefix}.{model_name} (e.g., custom_project) - View names: custom.{view_id}.{name} - Actions: {prefix}.{name}
### 4. Security must be configured for new models - Default: read/write for all users, only admins can delete - After create_model, call create_access_rights
### 5. Propose complete solutions Lead the user by suggesting a complete flow: model + fields + views + menu + access rights
